heading.$description: Primary (digital + print). Filson Pro family — used for headlines, body, UI, all digital surfaces. Pair with weights: regular 400, medium 500, bold 700; italic (style) for publication names and emphasis.

accent.$description: PRINT ONLY (CMYK). Young Serif — accent for printed subheadings, pull quotes, short highlights. DIGITAL RESTRICTION: never load or use on web; the --font-family-accent CSS variable is emitted only for print-mock surfaces and must not be referenced by shipped digital components.

body.$description: Primary (digital + print). Filson Pro family for body, descriptions, supporting copy.

regular.$description: Regular — body text, descriptions, supporting copy.

italic.$description: Italic — STYLE not weight (use with font-style: italic). Reserved for publication names, artwork titles, emphasised phrases; use sparingly.

medium.$description: Medium — UI labels, navigation, callouts, subtle emphasis.

medium-italic.$description: Medium Italic — STYLE pairing (weight 500 + font-style: italic). Part of the Filson Pro six-style family (Brand Book v1.0 p.20).

bold.$description: Bold — headlines, titles, key points of emphasis. Heaviest weight in the system.

bold-italic.$description: Bold Italic — STYLE pairing (weight 700 + font-style: italic). Part of the Filson Pro six-style family (Brand Book v1.0 p.20).

normal.$description: 150% - body, inputs, buttons. Brand Book v1.0 p.22 requires body line-height not below 1.5.
